title: Add one-post Chrome debugger Input live spike
approved_decision: Use chrome.debugger only for one dedicated tab and one human-selected pending post to dispatch one press/release pair to the visible Activity control, then detach immediately.
unchanged_boundaries: no CDP Network, Storage, Cookies, DOMSnapshot, screenshots, or arbitrary Runtime evaluation
no source text, URL, author, credential, or DOM persistence
no automated search, scrolling, selection, or batch integration
